title: Principled Frameworks for Evaluating Ethics in NLP Systems
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its analysis focuses on ethical principles using examples of gender and dialect bias.

measurement_description: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It discusses theoretical ethical frameworks (deontological and utilitarian) for evaluating NLP systems in general.
